recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add these ValueSet profiles to FHIR core for FHIR-31395; future corrections to the migrated profile definitions or CRMI explanatory text should be handled in CRMI.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocab R5 request to update ShareableValueSet and add PublishableValueSet, ComputableValueSet, and ExecutableValueSet to FHIR core based on CPG/CQI/VSD-aligned profile analysis.
initial_application: The request was applied by HL7/fhir PR 2068 and git commit 93fadfaa2a89cdc46a2a2633431ebbc34f06fe74, which updated the ValueSet core implementation guide, modified ShareableValueSet, and added source files for PublishableValueSet, ComputableValueSet, and ExecutableValueSet.
additional_context: FHIR-38833 later added R5 notes pointing implementers to CRMI for updated profile guidance. FHIR-37959 then made the Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to remove the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable terminology-resource profiles from core and maintain them in CRMI with unchanged URIs; commit 3958dd1e7c2fd73ad1e94c66f8d0884df55695d5 removed the ValueSet profile StructureDefinitions and IG references. FHIR-47807's request to keep the R6 ValueSet profiles in core was retracted/Resolved - No Change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current core source edit is needed because ValueSet remains active but the FHIR-31395 profile artifacts are intentionally out of current core build scope, and built-scope narrative already points implementers to CRMI for the migrated profile family.

related_jiras.note: Added R5 notes that the shareable/publishable profile family would migrate to CRMI.
